instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium full shot. In a sunny park with palm trees, the man in the black-and-white leaf-patterned shirt and yellow pants (R1) on the left and the man in the black bowler hat and striped vest (R2) on the right embrace in a warm hug. The man (R1) has his back partially turned, while the smiling man (R2) faces him, arms wrapped around each other's shoulders. Bright afternoon sunlight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the grass.
